intro: Who looks after what in the Lenches, when the parish councils meet, and how to find or comment on planning applications.
meetingsNote: Next dates are worked out by src/_data/meetings.js from rule (weekday 0=Sun..6=Sat, nth, months 1-12). Set override to YYYY-MM-DD for a one-off moved meeting; it is ignored once past. No rule and no override = 'see the meetings page'.

parishes.name: South Lenches Parish Council
parishes.covers: Church Lench, Ab Lench, Atch Lench, Sheriffs Lench
parishes.meets: Meets the second Monday of January, March, May, July, September and November, Church Lench Village Hall. Everyone welcome; public questions at the start.

parishes.name: Rous Lench Parish Council
parishes.meets: Meets every other month at 7pm, Rous Lench Village Hall. Open forum at the start of each meeting.

roles.title: Parish council
roles.text: Comments on planning, local open spaces, noticeboards, the Neighbourhood Plan.

roles.title: Wychavon District
roles.text: Planning decisions, bins, council tax, housing, licensing.

roles.title: Worcestershire County
roles.text: Roads, potholes, streetlights, footpaths, schools, libraries, social care.

planning.text: Search applications and comment online on Wychavon's planning site. The parish council is consulted on applications in its area and can comment on your behalf.
